name: Orphaned Parameter
hint: If you delete a former defined parameter from a block definition, make sure all instances of usage of the parameter get deleted as well.
instruction: When deleting the definition of a self defined block parameter without deleting every instance of usage.[newLine]To fix an orphaned paramter, the paramter every instance of usage can be deleted or if the paramter existed from a valid reason, redefin it.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
define sing
set volume to (100) %
repeat (count :: #ff6680) :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
play sound (LadyGaga v) until done
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
define sing
set volume to (100) %
repeat (3) :: #007000 //⇦  👍
play sound (LadyGaga v) until done
end
